proposed_global_claims.statement: The normalization-seed differential saturation is finite if and only if the finite normalization is unramified in codimension one.
At a generic height-one point of the full finite-cover permutation connection, an embedded ordinary coherent lattice exists if and only if local inertia is trivial.
Regular holonomicity and coherent logarithmic extension do not imply ordinary structure-sheaf finiteness or translation stability.

Derive trivial height-one inertia from the polynomial Keller source; a direct global D-module route additionally requires global ordinary coherence and a torsion-free meromorphic embedding with generic fiber L.

The audited dual, canonical, jet, and cohomological constructions do not bypass the inertia bridge; multiplier stability is a separate stable-order condition, and seed instability does not imply multiplier instability.
